title: Gokul's Data Signal 15
subtitle: Company layoffs · Read beyond the headline

source.name: Selected company disclosures · October–November 2026
source.description: Seven plan components across six companies. Purposive recent examples, not a representative layoff census. Global/company-wide scopes, not UK-only job losses. Announcement, consultation and completion are distinct. Null means not quantified in selected disclosure. Never sum percentages or infer counts from headcount.

evidenceFlow.title: Collect primary disclosures
evidenceFlow.detail: Read each row’s source and location; Imperial slide 29 is available via the search-indexed official PDF excerpt. Keep publication/event dates and timing qualifications. HubSpot timing comes from Note 17 of 4 November 10-Q.

evidenceFlow.title: Preserve reported measurement
evidenceFlow.detail: Transcribe counts, ranges and percentages separately. Store nearly 660 as a qualified display value. Keep missing values null; no imputed job counts or sector/economy totals.

metricDefinitions.label: Reported workforce share (%)
metricDefinitions.definition: Approximate proportion of the company workforce or positions covered by the specified plan, as disclosed; not share of jobs already lost.

metricDefinitions.label: Reported roles
metricDefinitions.definition: Number of roles in a disclosed plan component; preserve approximate/nearly qualifiers and expected ranges. Imperial current and further programmes are separate.

methods.code: Seven rows representing six companies. Retain separate Imperial current and expected-future components. For roles charts, filter non-null roles and display lower and upper endpoints, never add endpoints. For workforce share, filter non-null share and deduplicate by company. No aggregate layoffs estimate.

rows.label: Imperial · existing programme
rows.timing: FY26 programme; exits confirmed or under consultation
rows.ai: AI tools discussed alongside efficiency; no job-by-job causal attribution
rows.note: Do not treat consultation as completed exits. Separate from further reductions to 2030.

rows.label: Imperial · further by 2030
rows.ai: AI tools discussed alongside efficiency; no job-by-job causal attribution
rows.note: 2,100–2,500 further roles; upper bound is not a completed count.

rows.label: FICO
rows.timing: Substantially complete by end of fiscal Q3 2027
rows.reason: Fewer layers, process changes and AI-driven product development
rows.ai: AI-driven product development explicitly included among several changes
rows.note: Plan committed 1 October; notification began week of 5 October. No count inferred from a percentage.

rows.label: HubSpot
rows.timing: Substantially complete by end of Q1 2027, subject to local requirements
rows.reason: Organisation aligned with strategy; fewer layers
rows.ai: CEO explicitly says the decision is not driven by AI-related efficiencies
rows.note: 660 is a rounded display of “nearly 660”, not an exact tally. Timing: 4 November 10-Q.

rows.label: Dropbox
rows.timing: Exit completion date not specified in cited disclosure
rows.reason: Align investments and team structure with product and growth priorities
rows.ai: No AI-efficiency cause stated in the cited reduction-in-force paragraph
rows.note: Announced 28 October, documented in 6 November 10-Q. Expense/payment timing is not an exit completion date. Earlier 2026 rounds excluded.

rows.label: FTI Consulting
rows.ai: No AI cause stated in cited restructuring paragraph
rows.note: Plan began Q3; all affected employees notified by 29 October. 4% of more than 8,200 is not an exact count.

rows.label: Angi
rows.timing: Exit completion date not specified in cited disclosure
rows.ai: No AI cause stated in cited reduction-in-force paragraph
rows.note: Mostly middle management and support functions. Charge timing does not establish completed exits.
